title: acer laevigatum subsp. cordatum
intro: Acer laevigatum subsp. cordatum, commonly known as Korean Maple, is a subspecies of maple tree native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The health benefits of Acer laevigatum subsp. cordatum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
